caption: The drawing consists of twelve rectangular panels arranged in three rows on a beige background, each panel depicting a different textile or wallpaper pattern. The patterns feature a variety of floral and geometric designs. The top row contains five smaller rectangles, with designs including small pink and yellow flowers with green stems, clusters of purple and blue flowers, a horizontal vine with multicolored flowers and red stripes, and reddish-brown florals on a light peach background. The middle row holds three larger rectangles; the left two show horizontal white stripes with either small multicolored bouquets or blue-tinted flowers, while the right panel has horizontal light blue stripes with brownish-orange fruit and dotted branches. The bottom row has four vertical panels. The leftmost shows colorful flowers and greenery with a section of black dotted border; the adjacent panel has a sparse pattern of small pastel flowers above and a dense border of black lace and blue roses below; the third panel shows blue floral motifs overlain with an ornate black lace pattern; the rightmost panel exhibits a pattern of small geometric shapes above, and below, intricate lace and fan-like shapes in dark maroon with scalloped edging on a beige background. Each panel is outlined with a fine black line, and the colors used throughout include shades of pink, red, yellow, blue, purple, green, brown, maroon, black, and beige.
title: Printed Cottons
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
